title: 30th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/30/1/2025).

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development, Dr Ali Haidar Ahmed: why was the student loan scheme, normally announced every January, still not announced by March, and will the application deadline change once it is announced?
Preliminary debate on a government bill, sponsored by Hoarafushi MP Ali Moosa, to amend the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010).
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Maldives Civil Aviation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé Central MP Abdulla Shazmee.
Report of the seven-member temporary committee on its review of the bill amending the Tobacco Control Act (Law No. 15/2010).
Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's nominee for membership of the Maldives Broadcasting Commission, under Article 6(b) of the Broadcasting Act (Law No. 16/2010).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the higher education minister about the late student loan announcement, opened debate on a Decentralisation Act amendment, continued the Civil Aviation Bill, and took up committee reports on the tobacco bill and a Broadcasting Commission nominee.
